product_one_liner.value: Octopus Deploy is a continuous delivery and deployment automation platform that helps software teams deploy, monitor, and troubleshoot applications across cloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments.
product_one_liner.notes: Product description on the official homepage.

pricing_page.notes: Official pricing page lists pricing options and plans.

named_customers.notes: The official customer-stories page was checked but did not reveal two named customers in scrape results. The Axpo case study is individually named and documented; not naming a second unsupported customer.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists company size as 201–500 employees; the official company page reports 250+.

hq_location.notes: Company HQ is identified in Brisbane, Queensland, Australia (South Brisbane locality).

founded_year.notes: The official company story says Paul Stovell started Octopus with his wife Sonia in 2012.

eng_blog.notes: The engineering blog has multiple qualifying technical posts, including work on Octopus Cloud architecture and platform engineering at scale.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation includes numerous product and developer articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The open job board lists Revenue Systems Specialist and Expressions of Interest roles, with no AI/ML/data-science role titles.

model_provider.value: Anthropic (Claude); the Claude Agent Step uses Claude Code and requires the customer’s own Anthropic API key and chosen Anthropic model.
model_provider.notes: The documentation names Anthropic for the Claude Agent Step; it says users supply their own API key and select the model, not that one particular model is used throughout the product.

compliance_certs.notes: The official trust page names ISO 27001:2022 and SOC 2 Type II. SOC 3 is also mentioned there but is not one of the certification categories requested. GDPR is described as a compliance requirement rather than a certification.

last_funding.notes: Reporting published October 8, 2025 describes an approximately US$30 million (A$45.6 million) funding injection from Insight Partners; the article does not specify the round stage.

raised_18mo.notes: The October 2025 funding was within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live board lists Revenue Systems Specialist and Expressions of Interest roles, not SDR, BDR, sales/business-development representative, or account executive roles.

launched_6mo.notes: Within the six-month window, the company announced the Octopus Intelligence Agent App integration with GitHub in June 2026 and described Octopus Feature Flags developments on November 5, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The current team roster is available, but the reviewed sources did not establish when C-level or VP-level people joined or whether any such person departed in the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The live Revenue Systems Specialist posting references the Salesforce-to-HubSpot migration.
